### Renamed

- `--ds-vert` → `--ds-vert` — Value corrected #89fc79 -> #53ff64. The 0.11 hex was eye-dropped from the charter PNG on the belief that the swatch label was a typo; the label was right. Name unchanged — re-check any hard-coded copy of the old hex. (batch 0.3)
- `--ds-accent (in charts, sparkline, bar-chart series)` → `--ds-chart-1` — Data series no longer read the themeable accent. Visually identical at the default theme (--ds-chart-1 is #ff2a00); a theme that overrode --ds-accent to recolour its charts must now override --ds-chart-*. (batch 0.3)
- `Wordmark ({ name, sub })` → `Wordmark ({ variant, label, name, sub })` — The geometric construction 0.x drew — a circle, a square and a diagonal line, the brand's three elements as primitives — is replaced by the produced lockups, as two `currentColor` variants: `horizontal` (the full name) and `square` (the monogram). `name` and `sub` are unchanged and still render `.ds-wordmark__name` / `__sub`, but they no longer default: a bare <Wordmark /> is now the lockup alone, where it used to print the word "Diametral". A name beside the mark wants variant="square" — the horizontal lockup already spells it. `.ds-wordmark__mark` still styles a hand-written svg; the React binding emits none. `assets/logo/diametral-mark.svg` still holds the geometric mark and has not been re-cut to match. (batch 3)
- `.ds-wordmark, .ds-wordmark__mark, .ds-wordmark__name, .ds-wordmark__sub (in app-bar.css)` → `.ds-wordmark, .ds-wordmark__mark, .ds-wordmark__name, .ds-wordmark__sub (in wordmark.css)` — File move only, no rename and no visual change — the four rules left app-bar.css for the new wordmark.css when the real lockup landed. Anyone importing css/diametral.css is unaffected; only a consumer cherry-picking css/components/app-bar.css has to add css/components/wordmark.css. (batch 3)
- `.ds-button-group (in button-extras.css)` → `.ds-button-group (in button-group.css)` — Replaced wholesale, same name. The seam no longer overlaps members with margin-left: -1px; it removes the losing border with border-inline-start-width, which is identical in LTR and correct in RTL. Every selector matches both the new parts' data-slot and .ds-button/.ds-input/.ds-select, so existing markup keeps joining. New: [data-orientation="vertical"], .ds-button-group-text and .ds-button-group-separator. (batch 3)
- `IconButton ({ size: "sm" | "lg" })` → `IconButton ({ size: "icon" | "icon-xs" | "icon-sm" | "icon-lg" | "xs" | "sm" | "lg" })` — Additive, not a rename: `sm` and `lg` keep working, and `icon-` is simply stripped, so the source's four square spellings resolve onto the same boxes. `icon-xs` (24px, .ds-button--xs) is new. `label` was already required on both sides — the ledger's "incumbent is a class-applier" premise does not hold here, the same way batch-plan §1.1 found for stat-card. Moved from react/components/ButtonExtras.tsx to react/components/icon-button.tsx; the barrel import is unchanged. (batch 3)
- `GaugeChart, GaugeChartProps, GaugeChartThreshold` → `Gauge, GaugeThreshold` — Renamed with the absorption; every prop survives (`value`, `max`, `size`, `thickness`, `label`, `color`, `thresholds`, `format`) and the props interface is gone in favour of the inline type, the way every absorbed component declares its props. A find-and-replace of the symbol is the whole migration. (batch 4)
- `LineChart ({ series, data, labels, width, height })` → `LineChart ({ config, data, xAxisKey })` — Recharts replaced the hand-rolled SVG, so a series is named and coloured once in `config` — one entry per key in each `data` row — and the rows are objects rather than parallel arrays. `labels` becomes `xAxisKey`, the row field holding them; `width`/`height` become the container's box (`.ds-chart-container--plot`, retuned with `--ds-chart-height`). `grid` and `dots` are unchanged. Same for AreaChart, which additionally gains `stacked`. (batch 4)
- `AreaChart ({ series, data, labels, width, height })` → `AreaChart ({ config, data, xAxisKey, stacked })` — See LineChart. `stacked` is new: two areas drawn over each other are usually meant to sum. (batch 4)
- `BarChart ({ data: BarChartDatum[] })` → `BarChart ({ config, data, xAxisKey, statusKey, max, horizontal, stacked })` — 0.11 took one array of `{ label, value, status }`; the rows are now recharts rows and the measure is a `config` key. `status` moves from the datum to `statusKey`, a row field naming the tone, and all six 0.11 tones survive (success, warning, danger, critical, neutral, info) — the source's own map had only four. `horizontal` and `max` keep their 0.11 names and meaning. BarChartDatum is gone. (batch 4)
- `StackedBar ({ segments, showLegend })` → `StackedBar ({ config, data, labelKey, showLegend })` — Still the share chart: each row is normalised to its own total. `segments` and their colours become `config`; the row label becomes `labelKey`. For raw magnitudes rather than shares, use BarChart with `stacked`. (batch 4)
- `PieChart ({ data, color, legend, size })` → `PieChart ({ config, data, valueKey, nameKey, legend })` — `valueKey`/`nameKey` name the row fields; a slice's colour is a `config` entry keyed by its name, which is also how the tooltip and legend find its label. `size` becomes the container's square box — retune it with `--ds-chart-height`. (batch 4)
- `DonutChart ({ data, centerLabel, thickness, legend, size })` → `DonutChart ({ config, data, valueKey, nameKey, centerLabel, centerCaption, thickness, legend })` — See PieChart. `thickness` is now a percentage of the chart radius, not px, because the container is responsive and a px ring would not scale with it. `centerCaption` is new: the uppercase line under the figure, in the register Gauge uses. - `Sparkline (flat series drawn along the floor)` → `Sparkline (flat series pinned to the middle)` — Props are unchanged. - `InputGroup `before` / `after`` → `InputGroupAddon` — An addon can now sit above or below the control (`align="block-start"` / `"block-end"`), which a two-slot prop pair could not express. (batch 7)
- `Checkbox `children` / `onChange`` → `FieldLabel + `onCheckedChange`` — The root is the box now, not a label around one. Pair it with a `<FieldLabel htmlFor>`; `indeterminate` is a real third state. (batch 7)
- `Switch `children` / `onChange`` → `Label + `onCheckedChange`` — Same shape change as Checkbox: the root is the track, and its name is a `<Label htmlFor>` beside it. (batch 7)
- `Tag `status`` → `tone` — Widened from four values to the same six every other status surface takes. `status` is still accepted and still maps. (batch 7)
- `Icon `strokeWidth`` → _removed_ — Accepted and ignored since the set became Phosphor: filled geometry has no stroke to widen. Still accepted rather than removed, because removing it costs a caller a build for no gain. (batch 7)
- `IconButton / SpeedDial / ToolbarButton `variant`` → `the full eight-value `ButtonVariant`` — Widened, not renamed: these narrowed to `primary | danger` while they were composed onto the incumbent Button. The second half of batches 1, 3 and 6's forward cross-batch imports. (batch 7)
- `.ds-card-content (source spelling)` → `.ds-card__body` — The absorbed part is renamed into the frozen grammar: `__body` is what this system already called that region. (batch 7)
- `.ds-card-header / -title / -footer (source spelling)` → `.ds-card__header / __title / __footer` — Renamed into the frozen BEM grammar `Card.js` and `docs/components.md` already taught. (batch 7)
- `.ds-panel-header / -title / -content / -footer / -row (source spelling)` → `.ds-panel__header / __title / __content / __footer / __row` — Same rename. `__title` is what `<ds-panel title>` writes, so it is a contract and the other four follow it. (batch 7)
- `.ds-input (defined in field.css)` → `.ds-input (defined in input.css)` — Declarations moved file, name unchanged. Four stylesheets override it by descent — `color-picker.css`, `time-picker.css`, `date-picker.css`, `date-range.css` — and all four win on specificity, so none of them moved. (batch 7)
- `.ds-checkbox / .ds-textarea / .ds-select / .ds-range / .ds-input-group (defined in form-controls.css)` → `the same names, in checkbox.css / textarea.css / select.css / slider.css / input-group.css` — `form-controls.css` split seven ways and kept only the radio block. Every class name is unchanged; only the file it lives in moved. `.ds-field--error`, `.ds-field--success` and `.ds-field__hint` moved to `field.css`. (batch 7)
- `.ds-agenda-event-status--info / --success / --warning / --danger / --critical` → `.ds-status--info / --success / --warning / --danger / --critical` — The agenda's status dot is a `<Status><StatusIndicator/>` now, so its six private tone rules left `agenda.css`. One status is one colour system-wide. (batch 7)
- `<svg class="ds-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">` → `<svg class="ds-icon" viewBox="0 0 256 256" fill="currentColor">` — Lucide -> Phosphor. Every icon **name** is unchanged, so no `<Icon>` or `<ds-icon>` call moves; hand-written `<svg class="ds-icon">` does, because the wrapper attributes and the geometry both change. (batch 7)
- `Tooltip (label + placement props)` → `Tooltip + TooltipTrigger + TooltipContent + TooltipProvider` — A defect swap, not a rename of convenience. 0.11's Tooltip put role="tooltip" on a sibling span with no id and no aria-describedby on the trigger, and had no Escape dismissal. `<Tooltip label="Save" placement="bottom"><IconButton/></Tooltip>` becomes `<Tooltip><TooltipTrigger render={<IconButton aria-label="Save"/>}/><TooltipContent side="bottom">Save</TooltipContent></Tooltip>`. The trigger MUST carry its own accessible name: the popup is visual-only by design and wires no description. Pinned by site/tests/tooltip-regress.spec.ts. (batch 8)
- `.ds-tooltip-host + .ds-tooltip` → `.ds-tooltip-content (+ .ds-tooltip-positioner, .ds-tooltip-arrow)` — Both grammars ship. The 0.11 pair is the CSS-only hover host and still works for hand-written HTML; the React <Tooltip> renders only the absorbed one. They share no class name, so no guard was needed. (batch 8)
- `Drawer (open/onClose/placement/heading/footer props)` → `Sheet + SheetTrigger + SheetContent + SheetHeader + SheetTitle + SheetDescription + SheetFooter + SheetClose` — THE MERGE. 0.11's one Drawer did two jobs and the absorption splits it, so `placement` lands on Sheet, not on the new Drawer. `<Drawer open placement="right" heading="Filters" footer={…}>` becomes `<Sheet open><SheetContent side="right"><SheetHeader><SheetTitle>Filters</SheetTitle></SheetHeader>…<SheetFooter>…</SheetFooter></SheetContent></Sheet>`. Earned on a measured defect: 0.11 had no focus trap and no portal, so Tab walked out of an open drawer. Pinned by site/tests/drawer-regress.spec.ts. (batch 8)
- `Drawer` → `Drawer (a different component)` — The name survives but the component behind it does not. The 1.0 Drawer is the swipeable sheet — snap points, a swipe axis, an optional grab handle — and is uncontrolled by default. A 0.11 `<Drawer open placement>` call site must move to `Sheet` (row above); it will not fail to compile on `open` alone, so this is the one row worth grepping for by hand. (batch 8)
- `.ds-drawer + .ds-drawer--right|left|top|bottom + .ds-drawer__head|__title|__close|__body|__foot|__spacer` → `.ds-sheet-content[data-side] + .ds-sheet-header|-title|-close|-footer (React), or unchanged (hand-written)` — The 0.11 grammar is NOT removed — examples/components/drawer.html, kitchen-sink.html and the demo's files.js write it by hand and nothing re-classes them. Only .ds-drawer-overlay is shared between the two grammars, told apart by whether it wraps a `> .ds-drawer`. (batch 8)
- `(none)` → `.ds-sheet-overlay, .ds-sheet-content, .ds-sheet-header, .ds-sheet-footer, .ds-sheet-title, .ds-sheet-description, .ds-sheet-close` — Net-new file, css/components/sheet.css, imported after drawer.css. (batch 8)
- `Kanban (items prop, seeded and then self-owned)` → `Kanban (items + onItemsChange, or defaultItems)` — A defect swap: 0.11 was 49 lines of HTML5 drag with zero ARIA and no keyboard path at all. The board is now a @dnd-kit lift/move/drop state machine — the grip is a real button, so Space lifts, arrows move, Space drops, Escape cancels. `items` is now genuinely CONTROLLED: passing it without `onItemsChange` pins every card. Seeding behaviour is `defaultItems`. `onMove` reports (itemKey, toColumnId) and fires only on a column change, not a reorder. Pinned by site/tests/kanban-regress.spec.ts. (batch 8)
- `.ds-kanban__col` → `.ds-kanban-column` — Flat kebab, per #157's C2. The three committed readers are re-classed in this batch. (batch 8)
- `.ds-kanban__col-head` → `.ds-kanban-column-header` — The column label now takes .ds-kanban-column-title rather than a bare span. (batch 8)
- `.ds-kanban__count` → `.ds-kanban-column-count` (batch 8)
- `.ds-kanban__list` → `.ds-kanban-column-list` — The drop-target highlight moves from `.is-over` to `[data-over]`, which is what dnd-kit sets. (batch 8)
- `.ds-kanban__card` → `.ds-kanban-card` — Now a flex row of a grip and a `.ds-kanban-card-body`; hand-written content belongs in the body or it sits beside the grip. (batch 8)
- `.ds-kanban__card-title` → `.ds-kanban-card-title` (batch 8)
- `.ds-kanban__card-meta` → `.ds-kanban-card-meta` — Carried over from the 0.11 grammar rather than dropped: the source defines no meta part, and the re-classed fixtures needed somewhere to land. (batch 8)
- `Skeleton (variant/width/height/count props)` → `Skeleton (className + style)` — Composition replacing configuration, the trade every applier in this migration makes. `variant` is the held stylesheet's own modifier — `<Skeleton variant="text"/>` becomes `<Skeleton className="ds-skeleton--text"/>`; `width`/`height` become `style`; `count={3}` becomes a map. skeleton.css is HELD (DataGrid renders .ds-skeleton--text), so every modifier a 0.11 call site used still exists. It also renders a <div> now, not a <span>, and carries no aria-hidden — mark the loading REGION with aria-hidden or role="status", which is what a screen reader actually needs. (batch 8)
- `AppShell` → `AppShell (+ persist, + shortcut)` — Additive, no call site moves. `sidebar`'s two cherry-picks (#164 A3): `persist` remembers the collapsed state in a week-long cookie, `shortcut` binds Cmd/Ctrl+B to the toggle. Both default on and both are no-ops without a `sidebar`. The other 23 of sidebar's composition parts do not port. (batch 8)
- `recharts (peerDependencies, optional)` → `recharts (dependencies)` — recharts is now installed automatically with the package instead of requiring a separate `npm i recharts`. No import path changes. (batch 8)
- `Accordion ({ items, multiple })` → `Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent` — Config becomes composition: items[] is gone, each row is an AccordionItem (its value is what defaultValue/value refers to) wrapping AccordionTrigger and AccordionContent. openMultiple replaces multiple; defaultValue/value is always an array (Value[]), whether or not openMultiple is on. (batch 13)
- `Alert ({ type, dismissible })` → `Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription, AlertAction, AlertDismiss` — type becomes tone (neutral | info | success | warning | danger | critical, plus a variant axis: default | destructive). dismissible is gone: AlertDismiss renders the close button but is deliberately stateless — the caller holds whether the alert is dismissed and stops rendering it. (batch 13)
- `SplitButton ({ children, onMain, variant, size, menu })` → `SplitButton ({ children, onMain, variant, size, tone, disabled, menu, menuLabel })` — Same name, real rewrite: built on ButtonGroup + DropdownMenu now (was a hand-rolled popover with its own outside-click/Escape handling). menu takes DropdownMenuItem rows, not arbitrary nodes. Moved from react/components/ButtonExtras.tsx (retired) to react/components/split-button.tsx. (batch 13)
- `Calendar ({ month, value, events, weekStartsOn, onSelectDate })` → `Calendar, CalendarDayButton` — react-day-picker underneath now (was a hand-rolled month grid). mode ("single" | "range" | "multiple") + selected/onSelect replace value/onSelectDate; defaultMonth replaces month. events is gone — a per-day marker is a components={{ DayButton: ... }} override composing CalendarDayButton, not a data prop. (batch 13)
- `CodeBlock, CodeBlockCopyButton ({ code, filename, language })` → `CodeBlock, CodeBlockHead, CodeBlockFilename, CodeBlockBody, CodeBlockCopyButton` — Config becomes composition: filename is a CodeBlockFilename child inside CodeBlockHead, code/html move to CodeBlockBody. language is gone — there was never a real grammar behind it, and the source ships none either. CodeBlockCopyButton no longer takes children/label: it always renders its own check/copy Icon and manages its own "copied" state. (batch 13)
- `BRAND_SWATCHES, ColorPicker` → `BRAND_SWATCHES, ColorPicker` — Compatible — the only row in the 28 with no prop change. Gains className. (batch 13)
- `Combobox ({ options, allowCustom })` → `Combobox, ComboboxTrigger, ComboboxValue, ComboboxInput, ComboboxContent, ComboboxList, ComboboxItem, ComboboxGroup, ComboboxLabel, ComboboxCollection, ComboboxEmpty, ComboboxSeparator, ComboboxChips, ComboboxChip, ComboboxChipsInput, useComboboxAnchor` — Config becomes composition: options becomes items on the root plus ComboboxItem rows inside ComboboxContent/ComboboxList. allowCustom has no direct replacement. MultiSelect is the friendlier options/value wrapper over this component's multiple + chips mode, for the common case. (batch 13)
- `CommandPalette ({ open, onClose, commands })` → `Command, CommandDialog, CommandInput, CommandList, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandItem, CommandShortcut, CommandSeparator` — Renamed and decomposed onto cmdk. The flat commands[] (grouped by a group field, each with onRun) is gone — CommandGroup's heading restores the grouping, CommandItem takes onSelect instead of onRun. CommandDialog is the ⌘K popup shell (a Dialog underneath); Command on its own composes inline. (batch 13)
- `DataGrid ({ columns, rows })` → `DataTable, DataTableColumnHeader` — Renamed, on @tanstack/react-table now. columns is a real ColumnDef[] (accessorKey/header/cell) rather than { key, header, render }; rows is data. Drops the old custom keyboard-navigable grid entirely (no grid/gridcell roles, no roving tabindex, no arrow-key cell nav) — the source doesn't cover that axis at all; see corrections.md. (batch 13)
- `DatePicker ({ defaultValue, min, max, placeholder }), DateLike` → `DatePicker, DatePickerTrigger, DatePickerContent` — DatePicker is Popover itself now; DatePickerTrigger/DatePickerContent are the parts it adds, composing a Calendar by hand inside. min/max are gone — bounding is Calendar's own disabled matchers ({ before }/{ after }). value is a real Date, not a DateLike (Date | string) — the type is retired with no replacement. (batch 13)
- `DateRangePicker ({ min, max })` → `DateRangePicker, DateRange` — Same name, real rewrite: owns its own Calendar in mode="range" now. value is { from, to } (real Dates, to optional) instead of an ISO-string pair; min/max are gone, no bound replaces them. showTime adds a TimePicker for each end. (batch 13)
- `DateTimePicker ({ step })` → `DateTimePicker ({ step })` — Compatible, but step changes units: minutes now, not seconds (step={15} where it used to be step={900}). Composed from DatePicker + TimePicker internally. Gains datePlaceholder. (batch 13)
- `Dropdown, MenuItem, MenuHeader, MenuDivider` → `DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuPortal, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuGroup, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuCheckboxItem, DropdownMenuRadioGroup, DropdownMenuRadioItem, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuShortcut, DropdownMenuSub, DropdownMenuSubTrigger, DropdownMenuSubContent` — Renamed and decomposed. trigger becomes DropdownMenuTrigger's render prop; MenuItem's as polymorphism becomes DropdownMenuItem's render. MenuHeader -> DropdownMenuLabel, MenuDivider -> DropdownMenuSeparator. Does not share a class vocabulary with Menubar/ContextMenu (.ds-menu__* — those are unaffected, separately landed net-new). (batch 13)
- `FileUpload ({ hint, name, value })` → `FileUpload, FileUploadIcon, FileUploadTitle, FileUploadDescription` — Config becomes composition: hint/name/value are gone, FileUploadIcon/FileUploadTitle/FileUploadDescription are children instead. onFiles, accept, multiple, disabled are unchanged. (batch 13)
- `FormField ({ label, htmlFor, error, hint })` → `Field, FieldSet, FieldLegend, FieldGroup, FieldContent, FieldLabel, FieldTitle, FieldDescription, FieldSeparator, FieldError` — Renamed and decomposed: label -> FieldLabel child, error -> FieldError child, hint -> FieldDescription child. data-invalid on Field itself replaces the error-truthy switch. The group mints no ids and reads no form library's state — htmlFor/id and aria-invalid stay the caller's to set, same as before. (batch 13)
- `Icon ({ size, strokeWidth, title })` → `Icon ({ name })` — Same name, quieter contract: size, strokeWidth and title are gone. Sizing is CSS (.ds-icon is 1em square, font-size drives it); an accessible name is role="img" + aria-label passed straight through, or aria-hidden for a decorative icon. Ported to reuse this repo's own larger icon-geometry catalogue (icons.tsx) rather than source's per-icon @phosphor-icons/react imports, to avoid a second copy of the same data. (batch 13)
- `MultiSelect ({ onChange })` → `MultiSelect ({ onValueChange })` — Same name, dangerous one: onChange silently stops reporting selection under the new component (it renders correctly, so nothing errors). Everything else — options, value, defaultValue, placeholder, disabled — is unchanged. No per-option disabled any more; filter it out of options at the call site instead. No id — pair with a label via aria-labelledby/aria-label. (batch 13)
- `NumberInput` → `NumberField, NumberFieldGroup, NumberFieldInput, NumberFieldDecrement, NumberFieldIncrement, NumberFieldScrubArea` — Renamed and decomposed onto Base UI's NumberField. min/max/step/value/defaultValue/onValueChange are unchanged; the steppers and the input are now composed children (NumberFieldGroup wraps NumberFieldDecrement/NumberFieldInput/NumberFieldIncrement) rather than baked in. (batch 13)
- `Popover ({ trigger, placement, title, arrow })` → `Popover, PopoverTrigger, PopoverContent, PopoverHeader, PopoverTitle, PopoverDescription` — Config becomes composition: trigger -> PopoverTrigger child, title -> PopoverTitle child (inside PopoverContent), placement -> side/align on PopoverContent. arrow has no replacement. defaultOpen / open+onOpenChange are unchanged. (batch 13)
- `Radio, RadioGroup ({ options })` → `RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem` — Radio is retired; RadioGroup keeps its name but options is gone — RadioGroupItem is one per option, composed as children, each drawing only the dot (no self-label, unlike the incumbent Radio). Pair each with a Field-wrapped FieldLabel/Label the same way any other bare control is. label.css's sibling rule updated to match (radio-group-item dropped from the self-labelling-control selector list). (batch 13)
- `Rating ({ onChange })` → `Rating ({ onValueChange })` — onChange -> onValueChange. Gains shape ("default" | "star") and disabled. max/value/defaultValue/readOnly unchanged. (batch 13)
- `StatCard ({ label, value, delta, deltaDir, animate })` → `StatCard, StatCardLabel, StatCardValue, StatCardDelta, StatCardSpark` — Config becomes composition: label/value/delta -> StatCardLabel/StatCardValue/StatCardDelta children, deltaDir -> direction on StatCardDelta, children (the spark slot) -> StatCardSpark wrapper. animate (count-up-on-mount tween) has no replacement — the source's version doesn't animate the figure. (batch 13)
- `TagInput` → `TagsInput` — Renamed only — value, defaultValue, onValueChange, placeholder, disabled, max are all unchanged. (batch 13)
- `TimePicker ({ defaultValue: string, name, placeholder, step })` → `TimePicker ({ defaultValue: TimeValue, picker, showSeconds }), TimeValue` — The value is { hours, minutes, seconds? } now, not a "HH:mm" string. name, placeholder and step (the quarter-hour-snap seconds prop) are gone with no replacement — there's no discrete step on the new dial/list pickers. Gains picker ("dial" | "list" | "none") and showSeconds. (batch 13)
- `Toast, ToastProvider ({ duration, children })` → `Toaster, toast, useToastManager, createToastManager, Toast, ToastProvider, ToastPortal, ToastViewport, ToastContent, ToastTitle, ToastDescription, ToastAction, ToastClose` — ToastProvider keeps its name but is now just the context provider — mount Toaster once at the app root instead (it wraps ToastProvider + the portal + viewport + list). Raise a toast with the standalone toast.add({ type, title, description }) manager, not useToast().show(). duration and children on the old ToastProvider have no replacement. (batch 13)
- `Tree ({ nodes, defaultExpanded })` → `Tree, TreeItem, TreeItemTrigger, TreeItemContent, TreeLeaf` — Config becomes composition: nodes[] is gone, a branch is a TreeItem (defaultOpen seeds it open) wrapping TreeItemTrigger + TreeItemContent, a childless node is a TreeLeaf. Drops the old custom roving-tabindex keyboard model entirely (no arrow-key expand/collapse) — the source's version is plain Collapsibles with no tree-specific keyboard layer; see corrections.md. (batch 13)
- `VerticalNav ({ items })` → `SidebarProvider, Sidebar, SidebarContent, SidebarHeader, SidebarFooter, SidebarGroup, SidebarGroupAction, SidebarGroupContent, SidebarGroupLabel, SidebarInput, SidebarInset, SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuAction, SidebarMenuBadge, SidebarMenuButton, SidebarMenuItem, SidebarMenuSkeleton, SidebarMenuSub, SidebarMenuSubButton, SidebarMenuSubItem, SidebarRail, SidebarSeparator, SidebarTrigger, useSidebar` — Renamed and decomposed — the near-total rewrite of the 28 (80 lines to 674, 23 exports). items[] with one level of nesting is gone; nesting is however many SidebarMenuSub levels a call site composes. isActive on SidebarMenuButton/SidebarMenuSubButton replaces active, same no-router-opinion as before. (batch 13)
- `Wizard` → `Wizard, WizardStep` — Compatible. Gains label, nextLabel, backLabel, finishLabel. Composes Stepper's parts for the trail now rather than drawing its own — with no StepperSeparator between steps, since stepper.css's connector is a ::after with no separator element to render (see corrections.md). (batch 13)
